views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.order_status,
  o.order_delivered_customer_date,
  -- extract year and month for later aggregation
  CAST(strftime('%Y', o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS INTEGER) AS delivered_year,
  CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS INTEGER) AS delivered_month
FROM
  olist_orders o
WHERE
  o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
views.description: Task: Compute a report that shows, for each month (January through December), the number of delivered orders in that month for each of the years 2016, 2017, and 2018, with one row per month and one co
validated_on: What is the highest monthly delivered orders volume in the year with the lowest annual delivered orders volume among 2016, 2017, and 2018?

views.name: chunk_view_0_1
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_unique_id,
  c.customer_city,
  c.customer_state,
  o.order_id,
  o.order_status,
  op.payment_value
FROM olist_customers c
JOIN olist_orders o
  ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN olist_order_payments op
  ON o.order_id = op.order_id
views.description: Task: Find the top three distinct customer_unique_id values with the highest count of orders whose status is 'delivered', and for each of these customers return that customer_unique_id, the count of t
counter_examples: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.

views.name: chunk_view_0_2
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.customer_id,
  o.order_status,
  o.order_purchase_timestamp,
  oi.order_item_id,
  oi.product_id,
  oi.seller_id,
  oi.price AS item_price,
  oi.freight_value,
  p.product_id AS product_product_id,
  p.product_category_name AS product_category_name,
  c.customer_id AS customer_customer_id,
  c.customer_zip_code_prefix,
  c.customer_city,
  c.customer_state,
  pay.payment_sequential,
  pay.payment_type,
  pay.payment_installments,
  pay.payment_value,
  r.review_id,
  r.review_score
FROM olist_orders o
LEFT JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN olist_order_payments pay ON o.order_id = pay.order_id
LEFT JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id

views.name: chunk_view_0_3
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.product_category_name,
  oi.order_id,
  op.payment_type,
  op.payment_value,
  op.payment_sequential,
  -- keep counts per (category, payment_type) possible later aggregation
  -- include product and order item identifiers to join/order aggregation later
  p.product_id,
  oi.seller_id,
  o.customer_id
FROM olist_products p
JOIN olist_order_items oi
  ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN olist_orders o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN olist_order_payments op
  ON o.order_id = op.order_id

views.name: chunk_view_0_4
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
  g.geolocation_lat,
  g.geolocation_lng,
  g.geolocation_city,
  g.geolocation_state,
  LAG(g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (
    ORDER BY g.geolocation_state ASC, g.geolocation_city ASC, g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix ASC, g.geolocation_lat ASC, g.geolocation_lng ASC
  ) AS prev_geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
  LAG(g.geolocation_lat) OVER (
    ORDER BY g.geolocation_state ASC, g.geolocation_city ASC, g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix ASC, g.geolocation_lat ASC, g.geolocation_lng ASC
  ) AS prev_geolocation_lat,
  LAG(g.geolocation_lng) OVER (
    ORDER BY g.geolocation_state ASC, g.geolocation_city ASC, g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix ASC, g.geolocation_lat ASC, g.geolocation_lng ASC
  ) AS prev_geolocation_lng,
  LAG(g.geolocation_city) OVER (
    ORDER BY g.geolocation_state ASC, g.geolocation_city ASC, g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix ASC, g.geolocation_lat ASC, g.geolocation_lng ASC
  ) AS prev_geolocation_city,
  LAG(g.geolocation_state) OVER (
    ORDER BY g.geolocation_state ASC, g.geolocation_city ASC, g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix ASC, g.geolocation_lat ASC, g.geolocation_lng ASC
  ) AS prev_geolocation_state
FROM olist_geolocation g
ORDER BY g.geolocation_state ASC, g.geolocation_city ASC, g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix ASC, g.geolocation_lat ASC, g.geolocation_lng ASC
